description: Make a video web-ready: H.264 MP4 that plays everywhere (or VP9 WebM), scaled, faststart, by quality level or to a target file size. Also turns a GIF into a video a tenth of the size. Returns the file, a poster frame and a <video> tag. Price: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Media tools: Video and audio chores for sites, apps and docs: turn a clip into a small GIF or animated WebP, compress video to web-ready MP4/WebM with a poster, pull thumbnails and a contact sheet, extract or convert audio with loudness normalization, draw waveforms, and probe a file for what will not play in browsers..

duration.description: How many seconds to keep. To the end when omitted.

format.description: mp4: H.264 + AAC, plays everywhere. webm: VP9 + Opus, smaller, slower to make.

mute.description: Drop the audio track (background and hero videos).

quality.description: high is visually lossless, medium suits web pages, low is for previews.

targetBytes.description: Aim for this file size instead of a quality level (25 MB for Discord, 8 MB for email).

video.description: Video file as base64 (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI or GIF).

name: media_tools_video_compress
